---
title: "Learn together. Build reproducible research."
---

This is a growing neuroimaging training and research guide for placement students supervised by Donggyurim. Each student learns from previous work and contributes improvements for the next cohort.

## Your first steps

1. Follow [Getting started](tutorials/getting-started.qmd).
2. Agree on a small research question and dataset with your supervisor.
3. Track your task in a GitHub issue and share work through a draft pull request.
4. Document the workflow and submit it for supervisor review.

## Explore the guide

- [Tutorials](tutorials/index.qmd): practical learning pathways.
- [Datasets](datasets/index.qmd): data access, provenance, and dataset limitations.
- [Techniques](techniques/index.qmd): methods, assumptions, and quality checks.
- [Student projects](projects/index.qmd): reproducible questions, findings, and lessons.

The sections currently provide a scaffold for future contributions; they do not yet contain validated analysis protocols.
